# Vellett Industrial Catalog Engineering

> Managed catalog engineering and ERP item master cleansing for industrial, PVF, electrical, and fluid power distributors. We turn dense manufacturer PDF datasheets into audited 20-attribute item masters for Epicor Prophet 21, Infor CSD, and B2B eCommerce.

## Primary Architecture & Pages
- Homepage: https://vellett.com/ - Executive overview, interactive before/after transformation canvas, supported ERP platforms.
- 5-Sheet Methodology: https://vellett.com/methodology/ - Detailed breakdown of the 5-sheet deliverable (ERP Master, Footnote Audit, Stockout Cross-Ref, Price Sync, Faceted Taxonomies).
- Catalog Services: https://vellett.com/services/ - Six specialized disciplines (New PDF Onboarding, Cross-Referencing, Price Sheet Reconciliation, Deduplication, Multi-Branch Harmonization, Footnote Auditing).
- Retainers & Pricing: https://vellett.com/pricing/ - Transparent monthly retainers ($0 Pilot, $1,500/mo Starter, $4,500/mo Growth, $12,000/mo Enterprise).
- Direct Desk & Sample Intake: https://vellett.com/contact/ - Direct intake form, Wilmington DE address, direct dialer (919) 339-1208.
- Technical Knowledge Base: https://vellett.com/resources/ - 11 in-depth architectural guides on Prophet 21, Infor CSD, BigCommerce, and industrial fluid power catalog data.
